desc: Derive the prefix-sum formulation and the exact DP recurrence, including base cases and valid ranges for `i` and `r`.
Implement the telescoping shortest-path reduction as a one-dimensional O(n^2) DP using prefix sums.
Validate the implemented solution against the provided examples and small brute-force partitions; report a SAMPLE TESTS verdict.
Add edge-case handling for `n = 1`, large values, and invalid states using a sufficiently large infinity value.
